description: Solve any triangle from SSS (three sides) or SAS (two sides and the included angle). Get all sides, angles, area and perimeter with the laws of cosines and sines.

faqs.a: Either all three sides (SSS) or two sides plus the angle between them (SAS). Those two cases determine a triangle uniquely.
From the law of cosines: for SSS, angle A = arccos((b² + c² − a²) / 2bc). For SAS the third side comes from the law of cosines first, then the law of sines gives the remaining angles.

faqs.q: What if my sides cannot form a triangle?
faqs.a: The tool checks the triangle inequality (each side must be shorter than the sum of the other two) and warns you if the inputs are impossible.

howto: Choose SSS (three sides) or SAS (two sides + included angle).
All three sides and all three angles are solved instantly.
Read the area, perimeter and the formulas used below.
title: Triangle Solver
